games.name: Memory Grid
games.description: A pattern of tiles lights up for a moment. Reproduce it from memory. The grid grows as you advance.

games.name: Quick Math
games.description: Solve as many arithmetic problems as you can before the timer runs out. Speed and accuracy both count.

games.name: Color Clash
games.description: Pick the ink color of the word, not what the word says. A classic Stroop test for attention and impulse control.

games.name: Sequence Recall
games.description: Watch a growing sequence of signals and repeat it back in the correct order without a single mistake.

games.name: Quick Sum
games.description: Numbers flash one at a time. Keep the running total, then enter the sum before the optional timer runs out.

games.name: Sudoku
games.description: Fill the grid so each row, column, and 3×3 box contains the digits 1–9 exactly once.

games.name: Queens
games.description: Place one queen in each row, column, and colored region so that no two queens touch.

games.name: Zip
games.description: Draw a path through every cell, hitting the numbers in order from start to finish.

games.name: Find the Number
games.description: Three disks share one center and spin in opposite directions. Pick the numbers in order, from 1 onward.

games.name: Find the Word
games.description: Short nouns are hidden in a letter grid. Trace each word in a straight line.

games.name: Slitherlink
games.description: Draw one closed loop. Each number says how many of that square’s sides belong to the loop.

games.name: Nonogram
games.description: Fill cells so every row and column matches its numbered blocks.

games.name: Kakuro
games.description: Fill each run with distinct digits that add up to the clue.

games.name: Hashi
games.description: Connect every island with straight bridges that match its number and never cross.

games.name: Nurikabe
games.description: Shade a connected sea around numbered islands, with no 2×2 pool.

games.name: Guess the Pattern
games.description: Arrange the color blocks, then check. You only learn how many are in the right place.

games.name: Odd One Out
games.description: Tap the one shape or color that does not match the rest of the grid.

games.name: Anagram Sprint
games.description: Tap scrambled letters into short words before the clock runs out.

games.name: Concentration
games.description: Flip cards two at a time and find every matching pair.

games.name: Reaction Tap
games.description: Wait for the pad to turn green, then tap. Early taps do not count.

games.name: Reverse Digits
games.description: A number flashes. Enter those digits in reverse as the length grows.

games.name: Missing Operator
games.description: Pick the one operation that makes the equation true.

games.name: Word Ladder
games.description: Change one letter at a time until the start word becomes the goal.

games.name: Mirror Match
games.description: Pick the copy of a shape that has been turned, or flipped in mirror mode.
